name: docker-dummyran
what_it_is: A Docker-based dummy 4G LTE Radio Access Network (RAN) simulator capable of performing the MME (Mobility Management Entity) handshake. It is intended for testing and development of LTE core network components without physical radio hardware.
protocols: S1AP (S1 Application Protocol — LTE RAN-to-MME interface)
SCTP (Stream Control Transmission Protocol — transport for S1AP)
configuration: MME IP address / hostname (target for S1AP connection)
modes: Dummy RAN mode: initiates S1 Setup Request toward a real or simulated MME
constraints: Repository returned HTTP 404 at fetch time — may be deleted, renamed, or private; all fields derived from entry metadata and known LTE S1AP conventions, not from live source
Simulates only the control-plane MME handshake (S1 Setup); does not simulate user-plane (GTP-U) traffic or full E-UTRAN functionality
notable_absences: No live README or docker-compose.yml was retrievable (repo 404)
No built-in traffic generation or load testing capability
